rationale: Nearly all of hsliuustc0106's per-owner comments and two of the three Copilot comments were already fixed by the shown head diff; Y explicitly cross-references git history and reports most of them as '[resolved] ... fixed in <sha>', demonstrating it actually found and verified almost the full ground-truth set, while X never engages with these at all and instead frames several already-approved changes (e.g. the diffusion_model_integration owner swap, model_extras/@princepride) as fresh 'unannounced'/'blocking' violations, which is grounded in the diff but contradicts what reviewers actually intended. Both independently catch the two genuinely live issues (RuixiangMa missing from diffusion/models/, offloader.md PR-description vs Isotr0py mismatch, LoRA narrowing contradiction) with precise file/line fixes, so actionability is comparably strong for both, but Y's higher-fidelity alignment with the actual reviewer history gives it clearly better recall and slightly better precision.
